title: Deliver Livestock to Dardington Factory
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Livestock** delivered to **Dardington Factory** (industry id 59, near tile 199,29).

A likely supplier is **Fort Sinnway Farm** (industry id 56, near tile 190,46); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **550 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
